hypothesis.claim: A source-complete parent-preserving J implementation can pass exact 250KB fork/rejoin identity, and on the eventual exact 10MB population where the source-defined CMIX midpoint oracle remains target-scale and causal, J retains at least four fifths of F's arithmetic archive gain.
hypothesis.falsification: Any 250KB implementation, exactness, rejoin, resource, or package failure blocks scientific attribution; at the decisive 10MB gate the local-fork hypothesis is false if exact archive arithmetic gives 5*(archive(P)-archive(J)) < 4*(archive(P)-archive(F)).

changedMechanism: Change only persistence at the boundary after byte 63: F retains the aligned midpoint update, optimizer writes, and rebuilt trajectory; J discards every adapted branch write and continues from a simultaneously advanced untouched parent branch while preserving the coder interval produced by J's adapted probabilities.
invariants: P, F, J, and S use one content-addressed source tree, binary, frontend, coder, population, numeric contract, and ordinary parent update cadence.
F is exactly the source-defined shadow midpoint oracle v2 treatment and S is exactly its frozen 16-event causal misalignment.
J's adapted branch is probability- and state-identical to F from the midpoint through byte 63.
J's untouched branch is state-identical to P at every byte-64 join and consumes the same decoded truths at native cadence.
The arithmetic coder is never forked or rewound; only probability-affecting model state rejoins.
Truth-only state may be shared only after a source and writable-alias audit proves branch invariance.
No adapted parameter, optimizer, recurrent, mixer, SSE, context, memory, cache, cursor, schedule, or other future-probability write survives J rejoin.
The retention predicate is exact integer arithmetic: 5*J_gain_bytes >= 4*F_gain_bytes.
A below-threshold J result authorizes only functional-JVP persistence attribution, not a compact persistent codec.
Every archive, inverse, repeat, dependency, resource, and package result remains zero-credit attribution evidence.

controls.definition: Qualified q1 parent with no added midpoint update or branch.
Aligned 32-event oracle-v2 update and rebuilt trajectory whose parameter, optimizer, and model-state effects persist after byte 63.
Identical F update and adapted trajectory through byte 63, then exact rejoin to the simultaneously advanced untouched P branch without rewinding the coder.
Persistent F machinery with the oracle-v2 frozen 16-event rotation of first-half target associations.

population.unit: raw enwik9 bytes encoded through the complete reversible q1 pipeline
population.selection: Frozen opening 250KB implementation and exactness gate. A pass authorizes only a separately bound 1MB calibration; the 1MB pass may authorize only the separately bound 10MB decisive attribution.
population.coordinate: Nonoverlapping 64-byte modeled-stream segments with decoded first-half bytes 0 through 31 and predicted second-half bytes 32 through 63.

availableInformation: Decoded first-half truths and exact parent inputs, targets, activations, recurrent state, integer probabilities, and optimizer state available by the midpoint.
Current second-half truth only after its arithmetic decision, for synchronized post-truth updates of both J branches.
A source-audited partition of complete probability-affecting mutable parent state.
forbiddenInformation: Any second-half or future truth before its arithmetic decision.
Encoder-only gradients, traces, fitted archive outcomes, teacher probabilities, or closed runtime state.
Any adapted-branch write copied into the retained parent branch at rejoin.
Any coder rewind, recoding of the first half, or threshold change after archive observation.

measurements.definition: q1 policy v4 and shadow midpoint oracle v2 each supply the exact independently verified positive authority interface.
P/F/J/S encode, decode, raw inverse, repeat, dependency, and complete-population predicates pass.
All state-access, F/J adapted-trajectory, P/J untouched-parent, coder-continuity, alias, discard, and live-negative-control predicates pass.
Exact arithmetic archive bytes of P minus exact arithmetic archive bytes of F.
Exact arithmetic archive bytes of P minus exact arithmetic archive bytes of J.
F arithmetic archive is strictly smaller than S arithmetic archive.
F gain is positive and exact integer arithmetic satisfies 5*JGainBytes >= 4*FGainBytes.
Every arm passes the 9,765,625 KiB process-tree limit and remains strictly below the 10,000,000,000-byte cgroup cap.
The complete incremental attribution package is no larger than 65,536 bytes.
